mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edudoc_course_member tm WHERE tm.course_id = c.id AND tm.member_role = 'TEACHER' AND tm.status = 'A' AND tm.user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_course (course_code, course_name, term_code, teacher_id, status) VALUES (#{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{termCode}, HEXTORAW(#{teacherIdHex}), 'A')
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(id) FROM edudoc_course WHERE course_code = #{courseCode} AND term_code = #{termCode}
SELECT RAWTOHEX(u.id) AS userId, u.username AS accountNo, u.display_name AS name FROM edudoc_user u WHERE u.username = #{accountNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_course_member WHERE course_id = HEXTORAW(#{courseIdHex}) AND user_id = HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}) AND status = 'A'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_course_member (course_id, user_id, member_role, group_name, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{courseIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{userIdHex}), #{memberRole}, #{groupName}, 'A')
INSERT INTO edudoc_user (username, display_name, auth_source, account_status, last_login_time) VALUES (#{accountNo}, #{name}, 'ACADEMIC', 'I', NULL)
mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(a.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(a.course_id) AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, a.title AS title, a.description AS description, a.due_time AS dueTime, a.allow_late AS allowLate, a.submission_format AS submissionFormat, a.require_format_check AS requireFormatCheck, a.rubric_json AS rubricJson, a.status AS status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_course_member m WHERE m.course_id = a.course_id AND m.member_role = 'STUDENT' AND m.status = 'A') AS expected, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) FROM edudoc_submission s WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id) AS submitted, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.submitted_at > a.due_time THEN s.student_id END) FROM edudoc_submission s WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id) AS overdue, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'GRADED' THEN s.student_id END) FROM edudoc_submission s WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id) AS graded, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_submission s JOIN edudoc_format_check f ON f.id = s.format_check_id WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id AND f.blocking_issue_count > 0) AS formatIssues
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_assignment a JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE AND a.course_id = HEXTORAW(#{courseIdHex}) AND a.status = #{status} ORDER BY a.due_time
SELECT FROM edudoc_assignment a JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE a.id = HEXTORAW(#{assignmentIdHex})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_assignment (id, course_id, title, description, published_by, publish_time, due_time, allow_late, submission_format, require_format_check, rubric_json, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{idHex}), HEXTORAW(#{courseIdHex}), #{title}, #{description}, HEXTORAW(#{publishedByHex}), SYSTIMESTAMP, #{dueTime}, #{allowLate}, #{submissionFormat}, #{requireFormatCheck}, #{rubricJson}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(u.id) AS userId, u.username AS accountNo, u.display_name AS name FROM edudoc_course_member m JOIN edudoc_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN edudoc_assignment a ON a.id = HEXTORAW(#{assignmentIdHex}) AND a.course_id = m.course_id WHERE m.member_role = 'STUDENT' AND m.status = 'A' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edudoc_submission s WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id AND s.student_id = m.user_id) ORDER BY u.username

SELECT RAWTOHEX(a.id) AS assignmentId, c.course_name AS courseName, a.title AS title, a.due_time AS dueTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_course_member m WHERE m.course_id = a.course_id AND m.member_role = 'STUDENT' AND m.status = 'A') AS expected, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) FROM edudoc_submission s WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id) AS submitted, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'GRADED' THEN s.student_id END) FROM edudoc_submission s WHERE s.assignment_id = a.id) AS graded FROM edudoc_assignment a JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY a.due_time FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_assignment a JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.due_time BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_submission s JOIN edudoc_assignment a ON a.id = s.assignment_id JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = a.course_id WHERE AND s.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'LATE') AND s.attempt_no = (SELECT MAX(s2.attempt_no) FROM edudoc_submission s2 WHERE s2.assignment_id = s.assignment_id AND s2.student_id = s.student_id)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_submission s JOIN edudoc_assignment a ON a.id = s.assignment_id JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = a.course_id JOIN edudoc_format_check f ON f.id = s.format_check_id AND f.blocking_issue_count > 0 WHERE

SELECT RAWTOHEX(a.id) AS assignmentId, c.course_name AS courseName, a.title AS title, a.description AS description, a.due_time AS dueTime, a.allow_late AS allowLate, a.submission_format AS submissionFormat, a.require_format_check AS requireFormatCheck, a.status AS assignmentStatus, RAWTOHEX(s.id) AS submissionId, s.status AS submissionStatus, s.attempt_no AS attemptNo, s.submitted_at AS submittedAt, s.score AS score, s.feedback AS feedback, s.score_json AS scoreJson, RAWTOHEX(d.id) AS documentId, d.title AS documentTitle, RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS documentVersionId, v.version_no AS versionNo, NVL(f.blocking_issue_count, -1) AS blockingCount, CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_format_issue i WHERE i.format_check_id = f.id AND i.severity = 'WARNING') END AS warningCount FROM edudoc_assignment a JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = a.course_id JOIN edudoc_course_member m ON m.course_id = a.course_id AND m.member_role = 'STUDENT' AND m.status = 'A' JOIN edudoc_user stu ON stu.id = m.user_id AND stu.id = HEXTORAW(#{studentIdHex}) LEFT JOIN edudoc_submission s ON s.id = ( SELECT sb.id FROM edudoc_submission sb WHERE sb.assignment_id = a.id AND sb.student_id = HEXTORAW(#{studentIdHex}) ORDER BY sb.attempt_no DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) LEFT JOIN edudoc_document d ON d.id = s.document_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_document_version v ON v.id = s.document_version_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_format_check f ON f.id = s.format_check_id WHERE a.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'CLOSED') AND a.course_id = HEXTORAW(#{courseIdHex}) ORDER BY a.due_time

SELECT RAWTOHEX(d.id) AS documentId, d.title AS title, RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS versionId, v.version_no AS versionNo, d.status AS status FROM edudoc_document d JOIN edudoc_document_version v ON v.id = d.current_version_id WHERE d.id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) AND d.owner_id = HEXTORAW(#{studentIdHex}) AND d.status = 'READY'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_submission WHERE assignment_id = HEXTORAW(#{assignmentIdHex}) AND student_id = HEXTORAW(#{studentIdHex})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_submission (assignment_id, student_id, document_id, document_version_id, format_check_id, attempt_no, submitted_at, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{assignmentIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{studentIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{documentVersionIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{formatCheckIdHex}) NULL, #{attemptNo}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{status})

SELECT RAWTOHEX(s.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(s.assignment_id) AS assignmentId, a.title AS assignmentTitle, c.course_name AS courseName, RAWTOHEX(s.student_id) AS studentId, stu.display_name AS studentName, stu.username AS accountNo, RAWTOHEX(s.document_id) AS documentId, d.title AS documentTitle, v.version_no AS versionNo, NVL(f.blocking_issue_count, -1) AS blockingCount, CASE WHEN f.id IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_format_issue i WHERE i.format_check_id = f.id AND i.severity = 'WARNING') END AS warningCount, s.status AS status, s.score AS score, s.feedback AS feedback, s.score_json AS scoreJson, s.attempt_no AS attemptNo, s.submitted_at AS submittedAt FROM edudoc_submission s JOIN edudoc_assignment a ON a.id = s.assignment_id JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = a.course_id JOIN edudoc_user stu ON stu.id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_document d ON d.id = s.document_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_document_version v ON v.id = s.document_version_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_format_check f ON f.id = s.format_check_id WHERE AND s.attempt_no = (SELECT MAX(s2.attempt_no) FROM edudoc_submission s2 WHERE s2.assignment_id = s.assignment_id AND s2.student_id = s.student_id)
AND s.assignment_id = HEXTORAW(#{assignmentIdHex})
AND s.status = #{status} ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC
SELECT RAWTOHEX(s.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(s.assignment_id) AS assignmentId FROM edudoc_submission s WHERE s.id = HEXTORAW(#{submissionIdHex})
